group: Early Rcode Check

input.value: Message with question A.example.com, type A, rcode NOERROR

cases.expected: returns cleaned Message (not early return) because getRcode() == NOERROR
cases.description: Verify that when the response RCODE is NOERROR the method proceeds to normal processing.

input.value: Message with question A.example.com, type A, rcode NXDOMAIN

cases.expected: returns cleaned Message (not early return) because getRcode() == NXDOMAIN
cases.description: Verify that when the response RCODE is NXDOMAIN the method proceeds to normal processing.

input.value: Message with question A.example.com, type A, rcode SERVFAIL

cases.expected: returns the original Message instance (early return)
cases.description: When the response RCODE is neither NOERROR nor NXDOMAIN the method should return `this` unchanged.

group: DNAME handling – multiple entries in RRset

input.value: Message with question X.example.com, type A

cases.expected: throws WireParseException
cases.description: A DNAME RRset containing more than one record should trigger an exception when `throwOnIrrelevantRecord` is true.

input.value: Message with question X.example.com, type A

cases.expected: returns null
cases.description: Same situation as above but with `throwOnIrrelevantRecord` false – the method logs a warning and returns null.

group: DNAME handling – query type is DNAME (no synthesis)

input.value: Message with question D.example.com, type DNAME

cases.expected: cleanedAnswerSection contains the original DNAME RRset only, no synthesized CNAME
cases.description: When the query itself asks for DNAME, the method must keep the DNAME RRset but must not synthesize a CNAME.

group: DNAME handling – synthesize CNAME successfully

input.value: Message with question foo.example.com, type A

cases.expected: cleanedAnswerSection contains original DNAME RRset followed by a synthesized CNAME RRset with TTL 0 and target = foo.example.com → dnameTarget
cases.description: A single‑record DNAME RRset for a name that is a subdomain of the query name should cause the method to add a synthesized CNAME (TTL 0) and update the working `sname`.

group: DNAME handling – existing matching CNAME prevents synthesis

input.value: Message with question bar.example.com, type A, answer section contains DNAME RRset then a CNAME RRset that matches the expected synthesized target

cases.expected: cleanedAnswerSection contains both the DNAME RRset and the original CNAME RRset; no additional synthesized CNAME is added
cases.description: If the next RRset after a DNAME is a CNAME whose name equals the current `sname` and whose target matches the synthesized value, the method should skip synthesis.

group: DNAME handling – NameTooLongException during synthesis

input.value: Message with question verylong.example.com, type A, DNAME target causes name length > 255

cases.expected: throws WireParseException wrapping NameTooLongException
cases.description: When synthesizing a CNAME would produce a name that is too long, the method should throw a WireParseException if `throwOnIrrelevantRecord` is true.

input.value: Message with question verylong.example.com, type A, DNAME target causes name length > 255

cases.expected: returns null
cases.description: Same situation but with `throwOnIrrelevantRecord` false – the method logs a warning and returns null.

group: Irrelevant records in ANSWER section

input.value: Message with question target.example.com, type A, answer section contains RRset whose name is unrelated (e.g., other.example.com)

cases.expected: that RRset is skipped; cleanedAnswerSection does not contain it
cases.description: When an RRset in the answer section does not match the current `sname`, it should be ignored.

group: CNAME handling – multiple CNAME records in a single RRset

input.value: Message with question alias.example.com, type A, answer section contains CNAME RRset with two CNAME records

cases.expected: throws WireParseException
cases.description: If a CNAME RRset contains more than one CNAME and `throwOnIrrelevantRecord` is true, the method must throw.

input.value: Message with question alias.example.com, type A, answer section contains CNAME RRset with two CNAME records

cases.expected: returns cleaned Message where the CNAME RRset contains only the first CNAME record
cases.description: When `throwOnIrrelevantRecord` is false the extra CNAME records are removed and the method continues.

group: CNAME handling – ANY query type allows following records

input.value: Message with question any.example.com, type ANY, answer section contains CNAME RRset followed by unrelated RRsets for the original name

cases.expected: cleanedAnswerSection includes the CNAME RRset and also the subsequent RRsets whose name equals the original name (oldSname)
cases.description: When the query type is ANY, after processing a CNAME the method should also copy any records that share the original name.

group: Answer section – type mismatch removal

input.value: Message with question host.example.com, type A, answer section contains an RRset of type MX

cases.expected: MX RRset is ignored; cleanedAnswerSection does not contain it
cases.description: If the queried type is not ANY and an answer RRset's actual type differs from the query type, it must be ignored.

group: Authority section – forbidden types via switch

input.value: Message with question foo.example.com, type A, authority section contains RRsets of type DNAME, CNAME, A, AAAA

cases.expected: all those RRsets are ignored; cleanedAuthoritySection is empty
cases.description: The switch statement should cause DNAME, CNAME, A, and AAAA RRsets in the authority section to be ignored.

group: Authority section – disallowed type (isTypeAllowedInSection false)

input.value: Message with question foo.example.com, type A, authority section contains an RRset of type SRV (assume isTypeAllowedInSection returns false for SRV in AUTHORITY)

cases.expected: SRV RRset is ignored; cleanedAuthoritySection does not contain it
cases.description: When `isTypeAllowedInSection` returns false the RRset must be ignored.

group: Authority section – NS handling (subdomain check)

input.value: Message with question sub.example.com, type A, authority section contains NS RRset for name unrelated.example.com

cases.expected: NS RRset is ignored because its name is not a subdomain of the query name
cases.description: NS RRsets whose name is not a subdomain of the current `sname` must be ignored.

group: Authority section – NS handling (NXDOMAIN/NODATA suppression)

input.value: Message with RCODE NXDOMAIN, authority section contains NS RRset for a subdomain of the query

cases.expected: NS RRset is ignored because response is NXDOMAIN
cases.description: When the response code is NXDOMAIN, NS records in the authority section must be discarded.

input.value: Message with RCODE NOERROR, authority section contains SOA RRset and also an NS RRset, and ANSWER section is empty (NODATA case)

cases.expected: NS RRset is ignored because it is a NODATA response (SOA present and no answer records)
cases.description: In a NODATA response (NOERROR + SOA in authority + empty answer) NS RRsets must be ignored.

group: Authority section – duplicate NS handling

input.value: Message with RCODE NOERROR, authority section contains two NS RRsets for the same subdomain

cases.expected: first NS RRset is kept, second NS RRset is ignored
cases.description: Only the first NS RRset is allowed; subsequent NS RRsets are ignored.

group: Successful full normalization

input.value: Message with question www.example.com, type A, answer section contains DNAME (single), followed by matching CNAME, then A record; authority section contains valid NS and SOA; additional section contains related A records

cases.expected: returned Message has cleanedAnswerSection = [DNAME RRset, CNAME RRset (original, not synthesized), A RRset]; cleanedAuthoritySection = [NS RRset, SOA RRset]; cleanedAdditionalSection contains only additional records that are referenced by the cleaned answer/authority RRsets
cases.description: A comprehensive scenario exercising DNAME synthesis (skipped because CNAME already matches), CNAME processing, type filtering, NS handling, and additional section collection, resulting in a fully normalized message.

group: Irrelevant records in ANSWER with throwOnIrrelevantRecord true

input.value: Message with question target.example.com, type A, answer section contains RRset named other.example.com (irrelevant)

cases.expected: WireParseException is thrown because an irrelevant RRset is encountered and throwOnIrrelevantRecord is true
cases.description: When an RRset in the ANSWER section does not match the current sname and throwOnIrrelevantRecord is true, the method should abort with a WireParseException.

group: CNAME handling when query type is CNAME (multiple records, no trimming)

input.value: Message with question alias.example.com, type CNAME, answer section contains a CNAME RRset with two CNAME records

cases.expected: cleanedAnswerSection contains the original CNAME RRset with both CNAME records (no removal, no exception)
cases.description: When the query asks for CNAME, the multiple‑CNAME‑record guard is not triggered; the method should keep the RRset unchanged.

group: ANY query with DNAME synthesis and subsequent records for original name

input.value: Message with question foo.example.com, type ANY, answer section contains: DNAME RRset (single) for example.com → d.example.com, followed by an A RRset for foo.example.com

cases.expected: cleanedAnswerSection contains the DNAME RRset, a synthesized CNAME RRset (TTL 0, target = foo.example.com → d.example.com), and then the original A RRset (because query type is ANY the loop copies records whose name equals the original name)
cases.description: For an ANY query, after synthesizing a CNAME from a DNAME the method must also copy any records that share the original name (oldSname).

group: Authority NS handling when answer section is not empty (non‑NODATA)

input.value: Message with question www.example.com, type A, answer section contains an A RRset for www.example.com, authority section contains an NS RRset for www.example.com

cases.expected: cleanedAuthoritySection includes the NS RRset (NS is kept because the response is not NODATA and not NXDOMAIN)
cases.description: When the response contains answer records, NS RRsets in the authority section are allowed and should be retained.

group: Authority allowed type retained (MX) when isTypeAllowedInSection returns true

input.value: Message with question mail.example.com, type MX, authority section contains an MX RRset for example.com

cases.expected: cleanedAuthoritySection contains the MX RRset (MX is allowed in AUTHORITY section)
cases.description: If isTypeAllowedInSection reports true for a type (e.g., MX) the RRset should be kept in the normalized message.

group: Additional section records not referenced are omitted

input.value: Message with question host.example.com, type A, answer section contains A RRset for host.example.com, additional section contains two A records: one for host.example.com (referenced) and one for unrelated.example.com (unreferenced)

cases.expected: cleanedAdditionalSection contains only the A record for host.example.com; the unreferenced record for unrelated.example.com is omitted
cases.description: addAdditionalRRset should only copy additional records that are referenced by cleaned answer/authority RRsets; unrelated records must be dropped.

group: Irrelevant CNAME record in ANSWER (name mismatch) is ignored

input.value: Message with question target.example.com, type A, answer section contains a CNAME RRset whose name is other.example.com (does not match current sname)

cases.expected: cleanedAnswerSection does not contain the irrelevant CNAME RRset; it is skipped
cases.description: When a CNAME RRset's name does not equal the current sname, it is considered irrelevant and must be ignored.

group: Authority forbidden types – exception on throwOnIrrelevantRecord true

input.value: Message with question foo.example.com, type A, authority section contains RRsets of types DNAME, CNAME, A, AAAA

cases.expected: throws WireParseException
cases.description: Each RRset whose type is handled by the switch (DNAME, CNAME, A, AAAA) should trigger logOrThrow which throws a WireParseException when throwOnIrrelevantRecord is true.

group: Authority disallowed type – exception on throwOnIrrelevantRecord true

input.value: Message with question foo.example.com, type A, authority section contains an RRset of type SRV (isTypeAllowedInSection returns false for SRV in AUTHORITY)

cases.expected: throws WireParseException
cases.description: When isTypeAllowedInSection returns false for a type in the AUTHORITY section, logOrThrow should raise a WireParseException if throwOnIrrelevantRecord is true.

group: Authority NS handling – subdomain mismatch exception

input.value: Message with question sub.example.com, type A, authority section contains an NS RRset for name unrelated.example.com

cases.expected: throws WireParseException
cases.description: An NS RRset whose name is not a subdomain of the current sname must be ignored via logOrThrow, which throws when throwOnIrrelevantRecord is true.

group: Authority NS handling – duplicate NS exception

input.value: Message with question www.example.com, type A, authority section contains two NS RRsets for www.example.com

cases.expected: throws WireParseException
cases.description: The second NS RRset is considered a duplicate; logOrThrow should raise a WireParseException when throwOnIrrelevantRecord is true.

group: Authority NS handling – NXDOMAIN suppression exception

input.value: Message with RCODE NXDOMAIN, authority section contains an NS RRset for a subdomain of the query

cases.expected: throws WireParseException
cases.description: When the response RCODE is NXDOMAIN, NS RRsets in the authority section are discarded via logOrThrow, which throws when throwOnIrrelevantRecord is true.

group: Authority NS handling – NODATA suppression exception

input.value: Message with RCODE NOERROR, authority section contains an SOA RRset and an NS RRset, answer section is empty (NODATA case)

cases.expected: throws WireParseException
cases.description: In a NODATA response (NOERROR + SOA in authority + empty answer), NS RRsets are ignored via logOrThrow, which should throw a WireParseException when throwOnIrrelevantRecord is true.
